map.按科目自动归类错题，记录错误原因与掌握状态，到期自动提醒重练。数据保存在本地浏览: Auto-categorize wrong answers by subject, record the reason and mastery status, and remind you to retrain when due. Data is saved in the local browser.
map.结构化收录错题：按科目、题型（选择/填空/解答/计算）、错误原因、正确答案与复习: Structured capture: register by subject, question type (choice/fill-in/essay/calculation), error reason, correct answer, and review status to build a searchable personal wrong-question bank—no more paper copies.
map.按条件筛选复习：按科目或状态（未掌握/复习中/已掌握）过滤，考前只刷「未掌握」与: Filter review by condition: by subject or status (not mastered/reviewing/mastered); before exams only drill "not mastered" and "reviewing" to boost efficiency.
map.间隔复习提醒：记录每题复习间隔天数，按遗忘曲线安排复看，避免「会了就丢」导致考场: Spaced-review reminders: record each question's review interval and schedule re-view by the forgetting curve, avoiding "learned then forgotten" causing repeat exam mistakes.
map.示例：收录一道数学计算错题: Example: capture a math calculation wrong answer

: Subject "Math", type "calculation", stem "find ∫₀¹ x² dx", error reason "wrong substitution of integral limits", correct answer "1/3", status "reviewing", review interval 3 days;
In the notebook, filter by "subject=Math + status=reviewing" to list this item; when due (last time +3 days) it prompts a re-view, and a correct re-view can change it to "mastered".
map.错题本数据存在哪里？安全吗？: Where is the wrong-answer data stored? Is it safe?
map.数据保存在浏览器本机 localStorage，不联网、不上传，换设备/清缓存会: Data is stored in the browser's local localStorage—no network, no upload; switching devices/clearing cache loses it. Export and back up important content periodically. It is a personal study aid with no account or cloud sync.
map.怎样用错题本效率最高？: How to use the wrong-answer notebook most efficiently?
map.坚持「三要素」：错因要具体（不是「粗心」而是「积分上下限代入错」）、答案要完整、: Stick to the "three essentials": specific error reason (not "careless" but "wrong integral-limit substitution"), complete answer, and status updated with each review; spaced review (e.g., 1/3/7-day increments) converts to long-term memory better than one-time copying. This tool is only a management carrier—the study method is yours to keep up.
